page: Microsoft Azure E128-64as_v7 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the Easv7 family. It features a dedicated AMD EPYC 9V45 processor operating at 4.5 GHz, configured with 32 physical cores and 64 virtual CPUs via hyper-threading. The system is equipped with 1024.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 16.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage, relying instead on external Premium Storage, and contains no GPUs.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier single-core and multi-core CPU performance, with the AMD processor achieving top 10% scores in Geekbench and Passmark CPU tests. Memory performance is highly competitive, with read-only cached bandwidth reaching 6708.98 GB/sec and uncached write bandwidth at 133.05 GB/sec. The server demonstrates strong capabilities in database operations, software compilation, and text processing. However, for large-scale AI tasks, such as LLM inference on a 70B parameter model, performance drops to average levels, reflecting the lack of dedicated GPU hardware.

Given its massive memory allocation relative to compute cores, this server offers high resource density for memory-bound workloads without the added cost of bundled local storage or accelerators. It is highly suited for large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, enterprise applications, and memory-intensive data processing pipelines.
